body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> ACE CAD introduced a scan capture notepad called 'DigiMemo 692' during the CES 2008.

It features 6- inch x9- inch Size Digital Notepad with 32MB Memory which can digitally capture and store everything you write or draw with ink on ordinary paper. Users can connect this pad to their computer or laptop to send email directly. It is already available in the US market.
